{{Quote|Mission accomplished, sir. The Chancellor is safe.|The Coruscant Guard trooper after storming the Chancellor's Office|<ref name="Hostage Crisis">{{TCW|Hostage Crisis}}</ref>}}
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''clone''' served as a [[Clone shock trooper/Legends|shock trooper]] with the [[Coruscant Guard/Legends|Coruscant Guard]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]].

During the [[Senate hostage crisis/Legends|Senate hostage crisis]], this clone along with several other Coruscant Guards stormed the [[Chancellor's Suite/Legends|Chancellor's Office]] and secured [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] from any potential threats. He then notified [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Orn Free Taa/Legends|Orn Free Taa]] of the successful operation.

==Behind the scenes==
This clone first appeared in the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series in the episode [[Hostage Crisis]] which aired on [[March 20]], [[2009]].
